achievement.name: AI Essentials: Teachers (Module 1)
achievement.description: Awarded to St George's teachers who can use Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat safely and effectively for planning and resource-making, keep pupils' personal data out of AI tools in line with GDPR, and check AI output before it reaches a class or a parent.

criteria.narrative:
1. Complete the Module 1 video (approx. 3 minutes).
2. Score 3/3 on the safe-use knowledge check.
3. Submit one teaching resource made with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, with no pupil personal data, plus a one-line note on what you checked or changed.

alignment.targetName: EU AI Act, Article 4: AI literacy
